name: ElanMT
description: Dependency-free TypeScript inference for Mitsua/elan-mt-bt-ja-en (Marian ja-en)

scripts.build: vp pack src/index.ts && vp pack src/bloxd/index.ts -d remote/bloxd && vp pack src/bloxd/int4.ts -d remote/bloxd-int4
scripts.export:blockdata: npm run export:weights && npm run export:text && npm run export:schem
scripts.export:int4: python scripts/export_blockdata.py --bits 4 && node scripts/createSafe8Text.ts out/weights_int4.bin out/weights_int4_safe8.txt && node scripts/createWeightSchematics.ts out/weights_int4_safe8.txt schematics_int4 int4 elanmt-int4-weights
